translations.web: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.
translations.bsb: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
translations.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.
translations.asv: And if a son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon him: but if not, it shall turn to you again.
